elements.element: Renewals use a permitted mechanism: either renewal only by mutual written agreement or automatic renewal.
elements.evidence: The clause uses the permitted automatic-renewal mechanism.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term is twelve (12) months.
elements.evidence: The clause provides that each Service Option Attachment renews automatically for an additional term of twelve months.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer may prevent renewal by giving thirty (30) days’ written notice before the current term ends.
elements.evidence: Customer may elect to terminate by written notice at least thirty days before the end of the then-current term.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must give Customer a written renewal reminder at least sixty (60) days before the current term ends.
elements.evidence: IBM must notify Customer in writing of the upcoming renewal at least sixty days before the end of the then-current term.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent (3%).
elements.evidence: Renewal charges may not increase by more than the lesser of the preceding twelve-month U.S. CPI increase and 3% of then-current Charges.
Each Service Option Attachment renews automatically unless timely notice is given.

elements.element: Customer’s non-renewal notice window is no more than sixty (60) days.
elements.evidence: Customer is required to give only thirty days’ written notice, which is within the sixty-day maximum.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase is capped at five percent (5%) or less.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes the stricter cap of the lesser of CPI and 3%, necessarily no greater than 5%.

result.reason: The redline selects and fully implements the preferred automatic-renewal alternative: fixed twelve-month renewal terms, a thirty-day Customer opt-out deadline, a sixty-day IBM reminder, and the lesser-of-CPI-or-3% price cap. It also necessarily satisfies the fallback. IBM’s retained ninety-day notice deadline does not impair Customer’s required exit right and preserves the original counterparty notice arrangement.
